title: Critique: partial report is explained by unconscious storage

statements.text: In Sperling-type experiments the identities of uncued items may be stored unconsciously until the cue brings them into attention. Before the cue, only a few attended items and the sense that other items are present are conscious, so the results need no experience beyond access.
